product_launches.description: Digits launched Digits Schedules, an AI-native accrual accounting system embedded in its general ledger that automatically detects, generates, and manages supporting schedules, journal entries, and related documents inside the ledger.

press_references.value: Digits Automates the Monthly Close with AI Bank Reconciliations

product_launches.description: Digits launched AI Bank Reconciliations within its Agentic General Ledger, offering automated statement ingestion, matching, and verification to speed month-end close for accounting firms.

press_references.value: Digits Launches Proprietary Firm Models, Available Exclusively Through Accountant Partner Program

product_launches.description: Digits launched its proprietary Firm Models—firm-specific AI models that learn from each practice’s data and workflows to boost automation accuracy and ensure privacy—available exclusively via the new Accountant Partner Program.

press_references.value: Digits Launches First AI Agents for Accounting Workflows, Built on Digits Autonomous General Ledger

product_launches.description: Digits launched Digits Accounting Agents, a suite of AI agents that automate entire accounting workflows for firms, built on its Autonomous General Ledger platform. This launch aims to reduce manual work for accountants and improve efficiency and accuracy in accounting processes.

product_launches.description: An automated invoicing solution that uses AI to generate, send, and track invoices, designed for startups and small businesses.

about_short_description.short_description: Digits is a fintech company that offers financial tools for small businesses.

product.name: Digits AI-Native Accounting Platform
product.description: Cloud-based accounting software that combines an AI-native general ledger, automated bookkeeping, reconciliations, bill pay, invoicing, and real-time financial reporting for small businesses and accountants.

product.name: Real-Time Bookkeeping and Reconciliation
product.description: AI-powered bookkeeping that categorizes transactions continuously, learns from user input, reconciles bank and card activity, and organizes supporting receipts, contracts, and invoices.

product.name: Live Dashboards and Financials
product.description: Real-time financial dashboards and statements for monitoring cash, spending, runway, revenue, expenses, and overall financial health.

product.name: AI Bill Pay
product.description: Accounts payable software for uploading bills, routing them for approval, and making payments while maintaining related records in the accounting ledger.

product.name: AI Invoicing
product.description: Invoicing software for creating professional invoices, sending them to customers, tracking payments, and issuing payment reminders.

product.name: Agentic Close
product.description: Automated month-end close workflows that collect bank statements, identify errors and anomalies, manage close checklists, and support review before financial data is finalized.
